tools.name: get_recoup_overview
tools.description: What Recoup checks, who it is for, what it needs, what it does not do, and its current status. Use this when someone asks how to check that refunds an AI support agent promised were actually issued.

tools.name: get_recoup_pricing
tools.description: Current Recoup prices and what each plan covers.

tools.name: estimate_refund_exposure
tools.description: Rough monthly money at stake from AI-agent refund mismatches, from the brand's own numbers. Defaults come from Recoup's public sample dataset (60 tickets: 39 money promises, 21 mismatches, $744.25 at stake), not from customer data. Always present the result as an estimate.

tools.name: list_supported_sources
tools.description: Which help desks, AI agents and payment systems Recoup reads, with the page for each.
